summary: Items explicitly removed by the user must not be re-added in the next custom Jump List.

target.notes: Preserve Electron host/platform behavior rather than substituting a superficially similar .NET API.

semantics.constraint: removedItems must be respected by next custom categories

tests.name: normal
tests.input: // Electron host test: app.setJumpList($categories) after getJumpListSettings()

tests.name: edge
tests.input: // Electron semantic edge: app.setJumpList($categories) after getJumpListSettings()
tests.expected_behavior: re-adding removed items can suppress custom categories/violate host contract
